meta.source: github.com/CptNope/Alpha-Preclinical, main (approved November 2026 revision): design/design-system/tokens.json and README.md, plus values used in the approved pages and assets/css/site.css. Colours sampled from the logo and building signage.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand ink, the wordmark colour. Headings and body text on paper and mist (14:1). In dark theme it flips to near-white.

tokens.name: abyss
tokens.usage: Deepest wave band and the dark surface: hero, page headers, CTA bands, deep area sections. Text on it is white, shallows or ink-on-abyss only.

tokens.name: abyss-deep
tokens.usage: Footer ground only, one step below abyss so the footer reads as the floor of the page. Text: white and ink-on-abyss.

tokens.name: tide
tokens.usage: Primary action colour: buttons, links, the fifth strata band. Text on it uses paper (7.1:1 light, 6.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: strata-4
tokens.usage: Fourth strata band, between tide and current. Used only inside the homepage alpha. Never text.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Middle wave band, contour lines, the focus ring, icons. Never body text on paper (3.1:1).

tokens.name: strata-2
tokens.usage: Second strata band, between current and shallows. Used only inside the homepage alpha. Never text.

tokens.name: shallows
tokens.usage: Lightest wave band. Accent text, current-page nav and the light button on abyss (6.8:1).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate section ground, table stripes, the 'Led by' chip on paper, hover fill on list rows.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and the text colour on tide buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, author lists, metadata on paper and mist (7.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-abyss
tokens.usage: Secondary text on abyss and abyss-deep (7.7:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, list dividers, filter-chip and FAQ-icon borders. Decorative only: not a control boundary.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Form input, select and textarea borders at rest (3.3:1 on paper, meets the 3:1 control-boundary rule).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form validation only: invalid field border and its message. Never decorative.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text and logo on abyss, abyss-deep and tide.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero H1 only (fluid 40-84px on the site).

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Area and service headings on mobile; model rows (30px).

styles.name: heading-s
styles.sample: What species do you work with?
styles.usage: Card titles, paper titles (21-22px), FAQ questions (21px).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: PK/PD, efficacy and proof-of-concept studies, run by published scientists.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under an H1 or section heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We run them primarily in rodents, with capacity for most common laboratory species.
styles.usage: All running text and form inputs.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, captions, 'Led by' labels, footer base.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter; gap inside lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph and block gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading column and its content; mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding on desktop (area sections use 120px).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, the skip link, photo labels.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Photos, panels, team faces, the 'Led by' chip, dropdown panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, the motion toggle, icon circles. The only pill shape in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Header once scrolled; card hover lift. Pointer devices only.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Open dropdown panels only. Floating menus are the one place a heavier shadow is used.
